sources: sizes: the hotel's own capacity chart, on its events page (https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/atlpl-the-westin-peachtree-plaza-atlanta/events/, read 2026-10-03)

placement, order and orientation: the hotel's own floor plan, reference/plans/westin-floorplans-old.pdf, p. 7, measured from the centre of the ring of columns round the tower. The plan is from before the hotel's renovation, when Augusta A to H were the Atlanta Ballroom's A to H, and Augusta 1 to 3 were Augusta I to III; it is drawn south up, and is turned half a turn here (DECISIONS #28: read for position only, nothing copied)

today's names, room for room: the hotel's current floor plan of this floor, a picture on its events page (the same address; reference/plans/westin-site-2026-floor-7.png), which draws the walls where the old plan does
which rooms the con uses and which way is north: Dragon Con's 2026 map, reference/dragoncon/ (read only)
notes: the Augusta Ballroom east of the tower, towards Peachtree Street, and Augusta 1 to 3 in the west wing

Augusta A to H are the ballroom's eight sections, 127 x 104 ft together in the chart: A to D along the north side, west to east, and E to H along the south, east to west, with a corridor inside the ballroom between the two rows

the chart makes A and H, at the west end, 44 ft wide and 29 and 27 deep, and the other six about 28 wide and 44 or 45 deep. The plan draws A so, on the corridor, with rest rooms behind it. It draws H 32 ft deep over the western 35 ft of its width, an office behind it, and as deep as its row over the 9 ft at its east end; the hotel's current plan draws the same. H is drawn at the chart's 27 ft, on the corridor

Augusta 1 to 3 are the chart's 106 ft together, north to south, centred on the 104 ft the plan draws; the west wing's west wall slants, and they are drawn as rectangles from the wing's straight east wall
the Atrium is the open floor round the tower, drawn by eye
